items.snippet:
What do I do if SoloCam S340(T8170) goes offline?
1. Check the camera's battery level. If it is too low, charge the battery.
2. Press and release the SYNC button to check if the camera is switched off. If the LED does not light up, set the camera to ON in the camera settings or press and hold the camera for 2 seconds to boot up.
3. If you recently relocated the camera, try to move it closer to the

Why is SoloCam S340(T8170) showing offline in the app?
1. Check the camera's battery level: If it is too low, charge the battery.
2. Check if the camera is switched off: Press and release the SYNC button. If the LED does not light up, set the camera to ON in the camera settings or press and hold the camera for 2 seconds to boot up.
3. Check the camera's installation location: If you recently reloc

What should I do if SoloCam S340(T8170) goes offline?
1. Check the camera battery level. If too low, charge it.
2. Press and release the SYNC button. If LED is off, press and hold 2 seconds to power on.
3. If recently relocated, move closer to the router.
4. Remove the offline camera from the app and re-add it.

What should I do if SoloCam S340(T8170) has a poor signal or goes offline?
1. Set the HomeBase working mode to Performance: HomeBase settings > General > Working Mode > Performance (Beta) --- check if connectivity improves.
2. Move the camera closer to the HomeBase or router.
3. Check for signal interference (thick walls, metal objects, microwave ovens).
4. Restart the camera and HomeBase.

Does SoloCam S340(T8170) support a memory card and motion-activated recording?
Yes, the SoloCam S340 comes with a built-in 8GB eMMC for local storage. The camera is designed to record when motion is detected. Even if the solar power fails, the camera will continue to record using its built-in battery until it runs out of power. If the WiFi connection is lost, the camera will still record and save

Why has one of my SoloCam S340(T8170) cameras suddenly died?
1. Power Cycle the Camera**: - Remove the camera from its mounting. - Hold the sync button for 10-15 seconds to reset it. - Try reconnecting it to your HomeBase.
2. Check the Charging Status**: - Plug the camera into a charger and check for any LED lights. - If no lights appear, try a different charging cable and adapter.
3. Reconnect to

What should I do if SoloCam S340(T8170) WiFi connection fails showing incorrect password?
1. Confirm network compatibility. This device only supports 2.4GHz WiFi. Confirm the current connection is not on a 5G WiFi network.
2. Verify password accuracy. Check whether the entered WiFi password is correct, paying attention to uppercase and lowercase letters and whether special characters are entered c

Why isn't SoloCam S340(T8170) live-streaming?
1. Pull down the device list to refresh the device status.
2. Ensure the camera is online and has sufficient battery power.
3. Check the camera signal strength. Move closer to the router if signal is weak.
4. Press and release the SYNC button. If LED is off, charge the battery.
5. Remove the camera from the app and re-add it.

SoloCam S340 (T8170) is not powering on
1. Check the LED light when charging: Connect the camera to charge it and check if the red LED light flashes irregularly for about 1 second, followed by the blue light flashing 4 times and then turning off.
2. Check the binding button: After connecting the USB, press the binding button and observe if the binding light flashes and a "Beep" sound is heard.
3.

Why won't SoloCam S340(T8170) connect to Bluetooth, show video on my phone, or send notifications for garden activity?
1. Check Network Connection**
- Ensure phone is connected to a stable Wi-Fi network, preferably 2.4GHz.
- Switch between Wi-Fi and mobile data to see if the issue persists.
2. Reset the Camera**
- Press and hold the reset button for 10-15 seconds until a prompt is heard.
- Set up

Can I connect SoloCam S340 (T8170) to HomeBase S380?
Yes, you can connect SoloCam S340 (T8170) to HomeBase S380. There are two connection modes: it can be used by directly connecting to the router or by connecting to HomeBase S380. However, the firmware version of HomeBase S380 needs to be up to 3.3.2.6. After accessing the base station, the data is stored in the base station and shares the memory

What should I do if SoloCam S340(T8170) frequent power-off and WiFi disconnection?
1. Basic status check. Check the camera battery level first. If low, charge it before proceeding. Press the SYNC button to confirm the camera is powered on. If the LED does not light up, long press the power button for 2 seconds to power on.
2. Signal optimization. Set the HomeBase working mode to Performance (Homeb

Why did SoloCam S340(T8170) fail to connect to the Wi-Fi network?
1. Click the Devices tab, then go to Add Device.
2. Select S340 SoloCam.
3. Set the connection mode to "Connect to Router."
4. Hold the SYNC button on S340 SoloCam for two seconds until you hear a beep. Tap Next.
5. Turn on WLAN on your phone and join SoloCam's network.
6. Select your 2.4GHz Wi-Fi network and enter the password. Tap

How do I reset SoloCam S340 (T8170) without the app?
To reset the SoloCam S340 (T8170) without the app, you can perform a hardware reset by pressing and holding the button on the camera for 15 seconds or more. This should reset the device to its default settings. However, please note that this method is typically used when the camera does not have any light effect indication, such as when it does

Why does SoloCam S340(T8170) sometimes fail to detect objects?
1. Refresh the device list to update the device status.
2. Ensure the camera is online and has sufficient battery power.
3. Check signal strength and ensure it is strong at the installation location.
4. Review installation: Height ≤3 m, tilt ≤15°, side-mounted for optimal lateral PIR detection.
5. Ensure the correct detection type is c
